about_the_game:
[Story]

A week has passed since Yui's brother went missing.

Yui goes to look for him.

However, the village is contaminated with biohazards from a nearby laboratory.

Will Yui be able to meet her brother...?

[Contents]

Open-world action horror game

A game set in a beautiful countryside rendered with the latest Unreal Engine.

In story mode, you play as two main characters.

After clearing story mode, you will unlock mission mode.

Players can freely customize their characters.

*This work is fiction. It has no relation to any real person or organization.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64bit), Windows 11 (64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Corei3-12100 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 SUPER, Radeon RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 100 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64bit), Windows 11 (64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12400 or AMD Ryzen 5 5500
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 4060, Radeon RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 100 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended

short_description: A week has passed since Yui's big brother went missing. Yui goes to look for him. However, the village she finds there has been contaminated with a biohazard from a nearby laboratory. Will Yui be able to meet her big brother...?
supported_languages:
English, Simplified Chinese, Japanese*, Korean, French, German
*languages with full audio support
